history.content:
Hello, sweet! Yay, you are here! 

How are you today? Hiyori is so happy to see you!

I can do many fun things for you, sweet! 

Look! I can:
1. Talk with you to practice English.
2. Answer your questions.
3. Tell you fun stories and jokes.
4. Cheer you up when you are tired!

You created me, so I am here to help you every day! 

What do you want to do today?
